text:
<subject>Re: Urgent: Outstanding Invoice Payment Due by Tues 27/11 - Notice of Contract Breach</subject>
<body>
Alain -- My understanding was that Lumière Santé had met SantéPlus’ credit terms last week; however, below is a reminder that the invoice remains unpaid and Lumière Santé risks suspension from the SantéPlus clinical supply chain if the payment is not received by 27/11 COB.

Please advise if Clinical Operations should contact SantéPlus to resolve this. Jacqueline 37007.
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message----- 
From: Cousin, Richard 
Sent: Wed 19/11/2025 09:20 
To: Guilbert, Jacqueline; Robin, Philippe 
Cc: Boulay, Hugues; Laine, Emmanuel 
Subject: FW: SantéPlus CONTRACT BREACH - 18 Nov PAYMENT OVERDUE



FYI 

-----Original Message----- 
From: d992@pexcorcorp.com 
Sent: Tuesday, 18 November 2025 20:43 
To: helene.pruvost@lumieresante.fr; victor.hoarau@lumieresante.fr 
Cc: d742@sollumlabs.com; l184@sollumlabs.com 
Subject: SantéPlus CONTRACT BREACH - 18 Nov 
PAYMENT OVERDUE 
Importance: High 


> This is your formal notice that SantéPlus now considers your hospital group in breach of 
> the SantéPlus Supply Agreement for non-payment of your 5 November 2025 invoice by 1 p.m. today. Under Section 
> 15.1.3 of the agreement, you have three working days to cure the breach by full payment. If not remedied by 
> close of business Tuesday 25 November 2025, SantéPlus will declare default and suspend your participation in committee meetings, 
> halt clinical supply transactions, and revoke delivery services. A list of defaulting members will be circulated tomorrow. 
> 
> For questions regarding this notice or outstanding amounts, contact Margot Ferreira at +33 4 19 32 69 07 or Olivie Le Roux at 
> +33 4 71 47 75 05. 
> 
> Suzanne Daugherty 
> Controller 
</quoted>
